Method of Attack: Dropped via malicious attachments disguised as invoices in malspam emails targeting financial staff
Executed via .LNK file that runs a PowerShell script downloading the RAT from http://bit.do/e2VHR
Adds itself to startup folder for persistence

Capabilities include downloading and executing additional malware, uploading files, simulating mouse and keyboard input, starting processes, taking screenshots, logging keystrokes, stealing credentials, and exfiltrating system and user information
Impacted Systems: Computers of financial staff in North American hotel industry
Systems with browsers IE, Comodo Dragon, Yandex, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, Chromium, Opera
Mail clients including Outlook, Thunderbird, SeaMonkey, and others
